# get the function to retrieve sql properties
%run Utility/getSQLConnectionString

# retrieve sql connection_string and connection_properties
jdbcUrl,conn_Prop = getSQLConnectionString()

all_preseincarico_sql = """
WITH all_analog AS (
  SELECT
    iun,
    paid,
    'ANALOGICO' AS notification_cluster,
    left(`timestamp`, 7) as takenincharge_date,
    timestamp as presaincarico_ts,
    CAST(get_json_object( details, '$.analogCost' ) as INT) as price_paid,
    get_json_object( details, '$.productType' ) as paper_productType,
    get_json_object( details, '$.numberOfPages' ) as paper_numberOfPages,
    get_json_object( details, '$.envelopeWeight' ) as paper_envelopeWeight,
    get_json_object( details, '$.physicalAddress.zip' ) as paper_dest_zip,
    get_json_object( details, '$.physicalAddress.foreignState' ) as paper_dest_foreignState
    ,1 as recipients
    ,timelineelementid as eventId
	FROM 
	  fat_delta.pn_timeline
  WHERE 
      category in ( 'SEND_ANALOG_DOMICILE', 'SEND_SIMPLE_REGISTERED_LETTER')
      AND left(`timestamp` ,7) = "{mesediriferimento}"
      AND paid != '4a4149af-172e-4950-9cc8-63ccc9a6d865' 
), all_notification_withdest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
		iun, 
		senderpaid,
    sentat,
		size(recipients.recipientId) as recipients
	FROM fat_delta.notification
	WHERE 
	  left(`sentat`, 7) = "{mesediriferimento}"
	  AND senderpaid != '4a4149af-172e-4950-9cc8-63ccc9a6d865'
), all_digital AS (
  SELECT
    iun,
    senderpaid as paid,
    'DIGITALE' AS notification_cluster,
    left(`sentat`, 7) as takenincharge_date,
    sentat as presaincarico_ts,
    (100*recipients) as price_paid,
    '' as paper_productType,
    '' as paper_numberOfPages,
    '' as paper_envelopeWeight,
    '' as paper_dest_zip,
    '' as paper_dest_foreignState,
    recipients,
    '' as eventId
	FROM 
	  all_notification_withdest
), all_notification AS (
  SELECT * FROM all_digital UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM all_analog
)
SELECT * FROM all_notification 
""".format(mesediriferimento = mesediriferimento)

spark.sql(all_preseincarico_sql).createOrReplaceTempView("all_preseincarico")
